Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry announces its regular expert consultations for April and May in the following areas: taxation and invoice system, business law, human resources and labor, business succession and M&A, intellectual property, and Japan Policy Finance Corporation loans.

Each consultation session is held on a different date and time with different specialists. Reservations close 5 business days before each session at noon (for tax consultations); deadlines for other consultations are not specified. This is a member-only service. Tax consultations are free; fees for other consultations are not listed. Make reservations through the link below.

【April Schedule】
• Tax consultation: April 9, 9:30 a.m.
• Business law: April 21, 1:30 p.m.
• Human resources and labor: April 10, 10:00 a.m.
• Business succession and M&A: April 8, 1:30 p.m.
• Intellectual property: April 20, 10:00 a.m.
• Financing consultation: April 15, 1:30 p.m.

【May Schedule】
• Tax consultation: May 14, 9:30 a.m.
• Business law: May 19, 1:30 p.m.
• Human resources and labor: May 8, 10:00 a.m.
• Business succession and M&A: May 13, 1:30 p.m.
• Intellectual property: May 18, 10:00 a.m.
• Financing consultation: May 15, 1:30 p.m.

For details and to make a reservation, contact Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2622/
